speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is a bell. Faint. I cannot tell the church.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: South-east. That is all I have of it. The wind is off the river.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it be a bell to the south-east, and pass the bread.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In my trade a bell is a door. I do not ask whose door.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. Not this morning.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There are more of them now.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There are more loaves short in this town than bells, and I can do nothing about either. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The almanac has two words in it. I am in the house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The street is not your table, and the table is pease and the end of yesterday's loaf.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The thread is straight. I will sit, and I will not name a church I cannot see.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I open the casement?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. I can hear them with it shut.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are four people at a breakfast, and a noise. I will not make the noise into a guest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No guest. I have an afternoon to spoil upstairs, and I mean to begin it by not beginning.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is still faint. I cannot tell the church, and I will not guess one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not guess. The bread is the thing in front of you.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I hear a door, as I said. I do not hear a name.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: South-east is the whole of my direction. I am not adding a parish to it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The second bell is no nearer than the first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Near or far, it is not sitting down with us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The almanac says no play. That is why I am at this table.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will go back to the thread when the bread is done. The bells may go on without me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The casement stays shut. I can hear them well enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it shut. I have said so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Four people, a noise, and a breakfast. That is the house this morning. Eat.
